title: EMI computation and append-only repayment schedule generation

scope_out: must not define total_payable as EMI multiplied by tenure; must not expose an update or delete method on the schedule_installment repository; must not add a late fee, penal interest or prepayment quote to any installment row

entities.name: EMI computation and append-only repayment schedule generation

operations.text:
1. Define `LoanTerms`, `LadderState` and `LoanAgeing` value objects in `backend/src/types/loan_terms.py` (new), consuming `Money` from `backend/src/types/money.py` (owned by E9-S1).
2. Define the single EMI and residual implementation (D-C: every installment carries the 2dp-rounded EMI except the last, which absorbs the accumulated Rounding Residual so the schedule sums exactly to Total Payable, no epsilon) as `compute_installments(terms: LoanTerms, first_due_date) -> list[Installment]` in `backend/src/service/servicing/emi.py` (new).
3. Define `ladder_state(loan_id, as_of_date) -> LadderState` in `backend/src/service/servicing/installment_ladder.py` (new): the sole owner of the paid/unpaid Installment derivation and of Days Past Due, comparing the cumulative EMI ladder against the sum of posted `repayment_posting` amounts for the loan; published for E11-S2 and E12-S1 to read.
4. Modify `backend/src/service/servicing/schedule.py` (owned by E9-S2): replace the tracer's equal-split placeholder in `compute_schedule` with a call into `emi.compute_installments`, deriving the schedule's `emi`, `total_payable` (defined as the sum of principal plus interest over the stored rows, never EMI times tenure) and `rounding_residual` fields.
5. Add unit tests for the EMI and residual invariants in `backend/tests/unit/test_emi_residual.py` (new), covering AC1-AC4: the principal column sums exactly to the disbursed amount (AC1); total payable equals the sum of principal plus interest over the stored rows and the installment count equals the product tenure (AC2); the final installment's principal equals the balance remaining after all preceding rows (AC3); each period's interest is derived from that period's opening balance at the rate on the application's pinned policy version (AC4).
6. Add the architecture immutability test in `backend/tests/architecture/test_schedule_immutability.py` (new): scan the `schedule_installment` repository together with `src/` and `migrations/` for an exposed update or delete method and for any UPDATE or DELETE statement targeting `schedule_installment`, covering AC5.
